description: The single authority for which migrations the hosted acceptance runner applies to the acceptance Supabase project, in what order, and at what exact bytes. The runner loads ONLY this file. Filename pattern matching is not an authority.
authority: ENV-007 workflow hardening. Supersedes regex-based baseline inclusion/exclusion in scripts/rcap-hosted-acceptance-migrate.mjs.

baselineExclusionReasons.supabase/partner-seed-demo.sql: Schema-shaping demo data, not schema. Applying it is what first put tenant rows into the acceptance project.
baselineExclusionReasons.supabase/phase-56-public-view-and-defaul: Withdraws the default privileges that grant anon and authenticated everything on future objects. Applied AFTER the authorized sequence so the sequence's own tables get the canonical privileges.

manifestHashInput: sha256 over the newline-joined `phase:path:sha256` triples in manifest order

authorizationNote: Every member carries the acceptance-environment authorization recorded for it in data/rcap-staging-action.json. Membership in this manifest is NOT itself an authorization: the containing action record's status is "prepared_queued_not_authorized" and its "authorizes" list is empty. This manifest fixes WHICH migrations and WHICH bytes; Roger's authorization fixes WHETHER they run.

acceptanceAuthorizationGate.rule: Every manifest member must carry an acceptance/staging authorization that begins with the word "authorized". A member recorded as "queued" is refused before the first write.
